summary: Glacier NP two-story cab built 1935 on a spur south of Bear Mountain; sources differ: destroyed 1965 or removed April 1966.

facts.design: two-story frame cab, listed as an NPS structure
facts.status_note: Sources date the loss either to destruction in 1965 or to removal in April 1966.

visit.trail_note: A third-party hike guide describes a Bear Mountain Observation Point at the end of the Bear Mountain Trail, a spur of the Stoney Indian Pass Trail about half a mile northeast of Cosley Lake. The guide does not say it is the lookout site.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: firelookout.com and the Montana History Portal say destroyed in 1965; montanalookouts and WillhiteWeb say removed in April 1966. The sources do not say whether these describe one event or two, so the story gives both dates.

notes_for_editor: Build year and location agree across sources; the end date does not. Sources also call the site Bare Mountain and Crossley Ridge Lookout. The Montana History Portal has two Glacier National Park Archives photos (node 5165, HPF 5790, and node 5166) marked copyright undetermined; no image addresses were captured, so no photo entries. The hike guide is a third-party source, not NPS, and it does not link the overlook to the lookout site. Glacier trail status was not checked.
